entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Narrow, thin, tight; Wide, thick, full, fleshy, flabby, plump, big-lipped; Wrinkled, dry, flaking, drooping; Beaming, excited, impish; Stern, menacing, sneering, reptilian
entries.zh: 窄、薄、紧闭；宽、厚、饱满、多肉、松垮、丰润、厚嘴唇；起皱、干燥、脱皮、下垂；笑容灿烂、兴奋、顽皮；严厉、威胁、讥讽、爬行动物般阴冷。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Rose, curved; Pressed, pursed, pinched, puckered
entries.zh: 扬起、弯起；抿紧、噘起、紧缩、皱缩。

entries.en: Turned down at the corners in a permanent sulk
entries.zh: 嘴角下垂，仿佛总在生闷气

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She had a tiny rosebud mouth.
entries.zh: 她的嘴小巧得像玫瑰花蕾。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her mouth and plump lips rose in a perfect curve.
entries.zh: 她丰润的嘴唇扬起一道完美的弧线。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.zh: 他嘴唇厚，牙缝大。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her lips were pale and pressed into a tight, thin line.
entries.zh: 她的嘴唇苍白，紧紧抿成一条细线。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Saliva dribbled onto his chin from his limp, drooping lip.
entries.zh: 唾液从他松垮下垂的嘴唇淌到下巴上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a wide, full mouth that seemed stuck in a sneering smile.
entries.zh: 他的嘴宽大饱满，似乎始终挂着讥讽的笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her lips looked like they had been blown up by a bicycle pump and stuck in a permanent pucker.
entries.zh: 她的嘴唇像被自行车打气筒充了气，一直噘在那里。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She had a wide mouth and thick lips, which curved upwards into a broad, beaming smile.
entries.zh: 她嘴巴宽、嘴唇厚，嘴角上扬时绽开灿烂的笑容。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Molars, fangs, stumps, tombstones, false teeth, pearls
entries.zh: 臼齿、獠牙、残根、墓碑、假牙、珍珠。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Toothless, gap-toothed; Straight, crooked, jagged; Rotting, crumbling; White, brown, yellow, grey, gold-capped; Sparkling, polished, stained
entries.zh: 无牙、牙缝大；整齐、歪斜、参差；腐烂、碎裂；白、棕、黄、灰、包金牙冠；闪亮、光洁、有污渍。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 缺损、突出、凸出。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 像抛光珍珠一样的牙齿

entries.zh: 一大片洁白光亮的牙齿

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 露着无牙牙床的笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 两排参差不齐、发棕腐烂的牙齿

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 像崩裂的墓碑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 沾有污渍、磕缺的牙齿

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 满口黄牙

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Crooked teeth and cracked, flaky lips
entries.zh: 歪斜的牙齿和开裂脱皮的嘴唇

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 像獠牙一样伸出

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 斜斜地磕掉了一半

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 磨损成发黄的残根

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Clicked when she moved her lips
entries.zh: 她动嘴唇时发出咔哒声

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Curved down over his lower lip
entries.zh: 向下弯过下唇

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Teeth bared in a reptilian leer
entries.zh: 露出牙齿，阴冷地狞笑

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her teeth were like polished pearls.
entries.zh: 她的牙齿像抛光的珍珠。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a great sheet of polished, white teeth and a warm smile.
entries.zh: 他一笑便露出一大片光洁的白牙，笑容温暖。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her false teeth clicked when she moved her lips.
entries.zh: 她的嘴唇一动，假牙就咔哒作响。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A gold-capped molar glinted when he opened his mouth.
entries.zh: 他张嘴时，一颗包金的臼齿闪了一下。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His teeth jutted out like fangs and curved down over his lower lip.
entries.zh: 他的牙齿像獠牙般突出，向下弯到下唇外。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His teeth had worn away into yellowing stumps that looked like crumbling tombstones.
entries.zh: 他的牙齿磨成了发黄的残根，像一排崩裂的墓碑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Behind the thick fleshy lips, she could see his stained and crooked teeth.
entries.zh: 透过那厚厚的嘴唇，她看见了他沾满污渍、歪斜的牙齿。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: When he snarled, he revealed two jagged rows of brown, rotting teeth.
entries.zh: 他龇牙低吼时，露出两排参差不齐、发棕腐烂的牙。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Nose, nostrils, freckles, veins, hairs; Boxer, hawk, eagle
entries.zh: 鼻子、鼻孔、雀斑、血管、毛发；拳击手、鹰、雕。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Large, small, long, short; Thin, narrow, wide, broad; Straight, flattened, pointed, curved, turned up, hooked, broken, crooked; Pug, button, snub, triangle, beak-like
entries.zh: 大、小、长、短；细、窄、宽、宽阔；笔直、扁平、尖、弯、上翘、钩状、折断、歪；短塌鼻、小圆鼻、短翘鼻、三角形、鸟喙般。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 覆盖、扩展、延伸；鼻翼张开、紧缩。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had the flattened nose of a boxer.
entries.zh: 他有一个拳击手般的扁鼻子。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her small, upturned nose was covered in freckles.
entries.zh: 她小巧上翘的鼻子上满是雀斑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was a petite woman with a thin, perfectly straight nose.
entries.zh: 她是个娇小的女人，鼻子纤细而笔直。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His eagle beak of a nose made him look stern and arrogant.
entries.zh: 他的鹰钩鼻让他显得严厉又傲慢。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His wide nostrils flared with every breath like an angry bull.
entries.zh: 他宽大的鼻孔像发怒的公牛一样，随着每次呼吸翕张。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His bulbous nose was covered in swollen red veins and had clumps of dark wiry hair sprouting from the nostrils.
entries.zh: 他圆鼓的鼻子上满是凸起的红血管，鼻孔里长出一团团黑而硬的毛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He had a thin, scarred face and a nose that had been broken so many times it seemed to spreading across his right cheek.
entries.zh: 他脸瘦而有疤，鼻子折断过多次，仿佛已经歪向右脸颊。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He looked at them over his glasses, which were perched on the end of his large, hooked nose.
entries.zh: 眼镜架在他大鹰钩鼻的鼻尖上，他从镜片上方向他们望去。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She glanced down at him over her narrow pinched nostrils, as if he was a nasty smell under her nose.
entries.zh: 她抬着鼻子，从紧缩的鼻孔上方垂眼看他，仿佛他是鼻子底下难闻的气味。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Cauliflower, cabbage, bat, basset hound, satellite dish; Earlobes, earrings
entries.zh: 菜花、卷心菜、蝙蝠、巴吉度猎犬、卫星接收碟；耳垂、耳环。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Big, large, huge, enormous, small, tiny; Droopy, dangling, prominent, protruding
entries.zh: 大、宽大、巨大、硕大、小、微小；耷拉、悬垂、显眼、突出。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 突出、拉长、布满脉络。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 从头两侧向外支出

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Earlobes stretched into long, narrow ovals
entries.zh: 耳垂被拉成长长的窄椭圆形

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His huge, cauliflower ears jutted out on either side of his head.
entries.zh: 他的菜花状大耳朵从头两侧支出来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His ears were large and veined like a cabbage leaf.
entries.zh: 他的耳朵很大，上面的血管纹路像卷心菜叶的叶脉。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her earlobes were stretched into long narrow ovals by enormous, dangling earrings.
entries.zh: 巨大的悬垂耳环把她的耳垂拉成了细长的椭圆形。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His ears were so big it looked like he had two mini satellite dishes attached to either side of his head.
entries.zh: 他的耳朵大得像头两边各装了一面小卫星接收碟。
